verdict.rationale: Airbyte's own docs show each connection can run on a recurring schedule. The Schedule Type can be Scheduled, Cron or Manual, and syncs run from a user-defined cron expression set to a specific time of day or month. dbt Cloud transformations can also run right after syncs, which gives a light workflow chain. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that schedules can be set programmatically (via the API, Terraform or agents) rather than only per connection, and independent or hands-on confirmation of scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: For each connection, you can select between three options that allow a sync to run. The three options for `Schedule Type` are: Scheduled, Cron, Manual
If you prefer more precision in scheduling your sync, you can also use CRON scheduling to set a specific time of day or month.
Runs the syncs based on the user-defined cron expression
By using the dbt Cloud integration, you can create and run dbt transformations immediately following syncs in Airbyte Cloud.
